## Overview

**Token source (mode A, code-first):** `app/globals.css`: the `@theme` block (colours, type steps, spacing, radius, motion) and the `.t-<role>` type-role rules. This front matter is generated by `python3 scripts/design-md-sync.py`; `--check` fails when it is stale. Type steps and every fluid `clamp()` are computed by `scripts/type-scale.py`, never typed by hand. Front-matter sizes are the max of each clamp; the minimum is in the CSS comment beside it.

**Surface and reader:** snobi.jp, the Japanese-first store. The reader is deciding on a phone which 100g bag of organic specialty to try. The second door is for café owners (取扱店).

**Belief:** 「オーガニックのまま、スペシャルティ。」 / "Organic. And actually specialty.": organic can be actually specialty. This is the live copy (site-plan D8) and the only headline line. The roast date is **not** a selling point (owner, 2026-10-06): it is never a headline and never appears on the homepage.

**Named direction:** Daylight × Oryzo × Kettl, "a bag in Tokyo morning light": calm, tactile (owner, 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-06).

**Signature move:** the real bags arriving on the oak table in Tokyo window sun, from the 2026-10-01 footage (clip 6586): an empty sunlit table, then Peru falls into frame and lands, slowed with optical flow, then Mexico, Ethiopia and Colombia join it. No 3D (owner, 2026-10-06: "Drop 3d."). Each release below carries its proof: the 有機JAS mark, producer, altitude, process and cup notes from `content/products.ts`. That is how the page shows *organic* and *specialty*.
Animatic v1 (proxy, 14 s): `artifacts/footage/four-arrive-animatic-v1.mp4`; the final conform is from the 4K originals.
**Bold place:** the four-arrive film on Home. Everything else is restrained: paper, few type sizes, one fill colour.
**One dark moment:** the roast band on Story (footage `docs/footage-uses-2026-10-06.md` rank 1). No other page goes dark.

**Dials:** VARIANCE 7 · MOTION 6 · DENSITY 3 on brand pages; shop grid and cart DENSITY 5.

**Brand voice:**
1. Short declaratives that end on a full stop. Example: 豆のまま。
2. Facts, not adjectives. Example: 100g / 200g、豆のまま。
3. Never use "we show our work", never promote the roast date to a headline, and never invent taglines; copy comes from the live site and `content/products.ts`.

**Product context:** multi-page (Home, Coffee, Origins + 4 origin pages, Story, Journal, FAQ, Trade). Next.js 16 on Cloudflare Workers. Japanese primary; English in its own session. The cart hands off to tokyocoffee.jp checkout unchanged. Brief: `design/BRIEF.md` (approved 2026-10-06).

## Colors

- `primary` = `plum`: the buy fill and the logotype colour. It is the only filled button colour on the site, and it is also the dark-moment ground. `plum-700` is its hover.
- `accent` = `sage`: the focus ring (2px, offset 5px) and nothing else at body size. It reaches 4.20:1 on `paper`, so text in sage only at 24px or larger.
- `paper` is the page ground and `paper-2` the alternate section ground. Alternate them for rhythm; never use white cards on paper.
- `ink` / `ink-soft` are plum-black body and secondary text, never pure black.
- `line` is plum at 16%, for hairlines only.
- `lilac`: `::selection` and small marks only; never text on paper (2.20:1).
- `green` (celery): text on the dark moment only; it disappears on paper.
- **No origin tints as fills.** The `content/products.ts` origin colours are pastel fills, which are on the owner's never list. They may mark an origin only as a small swatch or rule, never as a card or section background (RULES D8, X4).
- **No second accent.** No amber, orange or promo red.

## Typography

**Faces:** Moret (Latin display), Maiola (Latin text) and 秀英角ゴシック銀 (Japanese), all from Adobe kit `xkh1hrz` via the JS loader, plus Geist Mono for labels, prices and eyebrows. Weights in the kit (VERIFIED from `xkh1hrz.js`, 2026-10-06):
- Moret: 400, 600, 700 (+ italics).
- Maiola: 400, 700 (+ italics).
- Shuei Gin: 400, 500, 600.

So **Japanese headings are 600; 700 would be faux bold.** Never ship a stand-in face; a page that cannot load the kit says so on screen.

**Stacks:** keep Georgia before the JP face in every stack, so Latin falls back serif→serif and the JP webfont never styles Latin.

**Scale:** a Utopia fluid scale, 320→1440px, body 16→18px, ratio 1.2→1.25, 12px floor.

| Token | 320px | 1440px | Role |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--text-step--2` | 12.0 | 12.0 | eyebrow, legal (the floor) |
| `--text-step--1` | 13.3 | 14.4 | labels, captions, JP notes |
| `--text-step-0` | 16.0 | 18.0 | body (Latin and JP), price |
| `--text-step-1` | 19.2 | 22.5 | lead, card title |
| `--text-step-2` | 23.0 | 28.1 | h3, JP heading |
| `--text-step-3` | 27.6 | 35.2 | h2, JP display |
| `--text-step-4` | 33.2 | 43.9 | page h1 |
| `--text-step-5` | 39.8 | 54.9 | section display |
| `--text-display` | 44 | 80 | the one Latin hero line per page |
| `.t-ja-hero` (step-5) | 39.8 | 54.9 | 「オーガニックのまま、スペシャルティ。」 in Shuei 600 |

The Latin display line is about 4.4× body at 1440, deliberately below Mockup D's 115px. The references run 2.3–2.9×; this one line is allowed more because it is the only display line on the page, while boldness still belongs to the bag (RULES D4). Display tracking is −0.035em at 0.98 line-height, inside the doctrine band for 72px and up. Re-measure on the served Moret at the first port and record the result here.

**Roles:** use the `.t-*` classes; never set font-size, weight, line-height or tracking anywhere else. Wrap Latin headlines on Japanese pages in `lang="en"`; JP text inside a Latin role gets +0.01em and weight 600 from `:lang(ja)`.

**Numerals:** prices and specs use `.t-price` (mono, tabular).
**Eyebrows:** `.t-eyebrow` is uppercase Latin mono. Use it on at most one in three sections, never on buttons (RULES X8).

## Layout

- **Gutter:** `--spacing-gutter`, 16→40px (Kettl 40/16, Oryzo 45/16.6). Grid: 12 columns desktop, 4 mobile.
- **Width:** content max `--container-content` (1328px). JP body measure `--container-measure` (36em ≈ 36 kana); Latin body 65ch.
- **Section pad:** `--spacing-section`, 64→96px. Sections alternate `paper` / `paper-2`: no two adjacent sections share a ground. Brand chapters use `--spacing-chapter-sm/md/lg` (50 / 65 / 80svh, Kettl); the bag chapter is a sticky stage.
- **Header:** `--spacing-nav` (64px) with the real boar and wordmark SVGs from `public/brand/`. Nav, 取扱店 (outlined) and the cart are always present.
- **Product page:** media ≈ 60% | buy panel ≈ 40%, both sticky below the header (Daylight 62/38, Kettl 883/453). On mobile the buy button sits inside the first screen, and a sticky buy bar appears once the main button scrolls away (Kettl).
- **Breakpoint checks:** 1440 / 768 / 390×667 / 360.

**Home skeleton** (recommended order; the film's place is the open owner question):
```
[header: boar+wordmark · nav · 取扱店 · CART]                       64px, always
[bag chapter, sticky stage ~4 viewports]                             paper + sun
   line beside the bag: Organic. / オーガニックのまま、スペシャルティ。 + 4種を見る
   drop → one turn → beans pour and pile → lineup of four with proof labels
[releases: 4 square photos on paper · name · notes · price · buy]   paper-2
[coffee-belt map: 4 numbered origins → origin pages]                paper
[Story link band (film / roast lives on Story)]                     paper-2
[footer: real logo · links · 特商法]                                 paper
```

Almost shadowless; depth comes from real light and the object, not from cards.

| sun | leaf-shadow layer, `mix-blend-mode: multiply`, `pointer-events: none`; darkest point no lower than `paper-2` | hero and bag chapter (Daylight); off under reduced motion |

## Shapes

- Commerce buttons and inputs are square (`rounded.none`): an object-like, printed feel.
- Release and product photos use `rounded.media` (4px, Kettl).
- Circles only for small marks (map pins, cart count).
- No pills, no large card radii.

## Motion

| Token (CSS var) | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `--ease-house` | `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)` | all entrances and hovers |
| `--duration-fast` | 200ms | press, colour |
| `--duration-base` | 250ms | hover lift on release photos (4px / scale 1.03, Kettl) |
| `--duration-slow` | 450ms | settle of the bag and the smoothed scroll (Oryzo ≈ 444ms to 99.5%) |

- **What moves:** the footage only: the four-arrive film on Home, the roast band on Story, and the /coffee header. Films autoplay muted and inline once in view, hold on their last frame (or a verified seamless loop), and have a pause control. Scrolling is native everywhere; no wheel `preventDefault`, no scroll-smoothing library.
- **What never moves:** the header, prices, cart totals, body copy. No fade-up on every section, no parallax-only motion, no wheel hijack.
- **Footage:** dissolves of 8–12 frames are the only transition. Falling beans play at 100% (slowing them ghosts the streaks).
- **Reduced motion:** still frames in normal flow, with the explanation kept.

- Real photography and footage from the 2026-10-01 shoot only (consent for all faces, owner 2026-10-06). Release photos are on paper (the dapple set), with the white-background set reserved for the cart and Shopify.

Hand-rolled (no shadcn).

**Buy button** (`button-buy`):

**Buy on the dark band** (`button-buy-on-dark`): a paper fill with plum text. This is the only place the buy button is not plum, so it stays visible on the Story band.

**Release card:**
- a square photo at `rounded.media`;
- name in `.t-lead`, notes in `.t-label` `ink-soft`, price in `.t-price`;
- no card fill or border;
- hover lifts the photo 4px.

**Origin map:**
- numbered pins (mono, tabular) with place names in `.t-h3`;
- hover or tap dims the others to 50% over 300ms (Kettl);
- separate mobile pin positions.

**Facts list:** label / value pairs (`.t-label` / `.t-body`), with a `line` rule between rows.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do keep exactly one filled colour (plum) for buying, on screen at every scroll depth of brand pages.
- Do set every size from a `--text-*` token through a `.t-*` role. Baseline: `app/globals.css` has 103 literal `font-size` values (2026-10-06). The count may only shrink (`grep -cE 'font-size:\s*[0-9.]+(px|rem)' app/globals.css`), and new files have none.
- Do keep JP headings at 600, with no negative tracking on `:lang(ja)`.
- Do put copy beside the bag, never over it or over a face or label.
- Do keep one dark moment site-wide (the Story roast band).
- Don't put the roast date in a headline, a scroll beat or on the homepage.
- Don't use origin tints or any pastel as a card or section fill.
- Don't use an index-with-image-swap, outlined ghost words, a pinned horizontal strip, a giant footer or hero wordmark, floating promo or newsletter cards, or a one-page scroll.
- Don't use stand-in fonts, stock footage, fast cuts or library transitions.
- Don't imitate the logo: use the real `snobi.svg` and `snobi_font1.svg`.

## Accessibility

- Every text/surface pair is a component entry and passes `npx @google/design.md lint` at 4.5:1 (0 errors, 0 contrast warnings, 2026-10-06; the 3 orphan warnings are non-text tokens: `sage`, `accent`, `line`).
- Focus is the sage ring. It is non-text, so `python3 scripts/contrast.py` checks it at 3:1 (4.20:1 on `paper`, 3.85:1 on `paper-2`).
- Targets are at least 44px; skip link; one H1 and one `main` per page; `lang="ja"` on the root.
- Content is readable without JS: every film has a poster still in the HTML (the final frame of the four arriving), and the video upgrades it. Reduced motion shows the poster only.

## Japanese

- Stack: Latin face, then Georgia, then `dnp-shuei-gothic-gin-std`, then system JP.
- Body is `.t-ja-body`: line-height 1.8, tracking 0.02em (inside the doctrine's 0–0.04em; this overrides RULES D5's "normal" for JP), measure 36em.
- Headings are 600 with `palt` and +0.01em.
- Use `line-break: strict` and `word-break: auto-phrase`, with `<wbr>` in short headlines that break badly.
- Half-width numerals and Latin set in the Latin face; full-width JP punctuation.
- JP and EN get their own line breaks.
